The reference discusses various shapes and contours for pole extension members and engagement surfaces, but it does not provide any specific dimensions or relationships between the length of projections and the thickness of a ferromagnetic workpiece.

overall.why: The reference describes a switchable magnetic implement with a housing, movable magnets, and exchangeable pole extension members with contoured engagement surfaces for workpieces, disclosing many core features of the subject invention.
